role_targets.label: IT Governance Manager
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior IT Governance Manager responsible for designing and operating the IT governance framework across the enterprise. Owns the steering committee cadence, RAID management, decision rights and policy framework. Coordinates audits and control assurance across the IT portfolio. Partners with CIO, group risk and compliance functions on policy frameworks for AI, cloud, data and SaaS investment decisions. Defines governance for ServiceNow ITSM and LeanIX as portfolio platforms. Reports to CIO and executive leadership; runs board-level reporting and storyline development.

role_targets.label: IT Process Manager
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior IT Process Manager responsible for end-to-end IT process design, standardisation, automation and continuous improvement. Owns the operating model for IT delivery processes, runs lean / six-sigma improvement programs, and embeds standard workflows across PMO, EA and operations. Drives ServiceNow ITSM workflow design, custom modules and Jira integration. Coordinates RPA and platform automation initiatives. Partners with portfolio, vendor and operations leadership on process governance, KPI design and operational excellence.

role_targets.label: IT Project Portfolio Manager
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior IT Project Portfolio Manager owning the intake, prioritisation and steering of the IT portfolio (60-100 concurrent projects, budgets up to 50 million EUR). Manages RAID, dependencies, capacity planning and contingency reserves. Designs and chairs portfolio steering committees, runs weekly portfolio syncs and quarterly CIO / board reviews. Coordinates ServiceNow / LeanIX adoption for portfolio reporting and EA integration. Reports to CIO and group governance functions on portfolio health, change-control and benefit realisation.

role_targets.label: IT Project Manager
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior IT Project Manager responsible for end-to-end delivery of strategic IT projects. Owns scope, schedule, budget, RAID and stakeholder communications. Manages cross-functional teams and external vendors across the full delivery lifecycle. Coordinates with EA, security, operations and business sponsors. Experience with hybrid and agile delivery, SAFe, Scrum, Jira and Confluence required. Drives go-live readiness, change control and post-implementation review. Reports to programme or portfolio leadership.

role_targets.label: IT Product Owner
role_targets.seed_jd: IT Product Owner owning the backlog, roadmap and stakeholder engagement for an enterprise IT platform such as ServiceNow ITSM, LeanIX or Jira. Defines features and user stories, prioritises the backlog with business stakeholders, and partners with development and scrum master on sprint planning, refinement and delivery. Drives platform adoption, integration design and continuous improvement. Coordinates custom module development and bidirectional integrations. Reports to product or platform leadership.

role_targets.label: Product Manager
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior Product Manager owning the product strategy, roadmap and stakeholder engagement for an enterprise platform or internal product. Defines the vision, success metrics and prioritises features against business value, dependencies and technical risk. Partners with engineering, design, sales and operations on go-to-market, adoption and customer success. Drives discovery, customer interviews, hypothesis validation and post-launch measurement. Reports to product, executive or business-unit leadership.

role_targets.label: AI Governance
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior AI Governance lead responsible for designing and operating the AI governance framework across the enterprise. Owns policy for AI investment evaluation, model risk, data lineage, vendor assurance and ethical / responsible use. Coordinates with CIO, CFO, legal, compliance and risk on AI use-case approvals, audit readiness and EU AI Act / regulatory compliance. Defines AI decision rights, steering cadence and reporting to the executive board. Partners with portfolio and EA functions on AI capability roadmap and platform investments.

role_targets.label: AI Evaluation Manager
role_targets.seed_jd: Senior AI Evaluation / AI Management lead owning the evaluation of AI investments and use cases across the IT portfolio. Designs the business-case scoring framework, ROI tracking model, hard-vs-soft benefit attribution and capability-adjusted projections on a five-year plan-of-record. Coordinates with CIO, CFO and business sponsors on AI investment decisions, vendor assessment and post-implementation review. Drives portfolio-level reporting on AI delivery, adoption and benefit realisation. Reports to CIO or AI executive leadership.
